H3301.name: Iphdeiah
H3301.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3301.short: Iphdeiah was a descendant of Benjamin through Shashak.

H3376.name: Irijah
H3376.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3376.brief: Captain who arrested Jeremiah for desertion.
H3376.short: Irijah, a captain, arrested Jeremiah on suspicion of desertion to the Babylonians.

H3327.name: Isaac
H3327.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3327.brief: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.
H3327.short: Isaac was the son of Abraham and Sarah, and the father of Jacob and Esau. God made a covenant with him, renewing the promises given to Abraham.

H3328.name: Izhar
H3328.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3328.brief: Son of Asher listed in the genealogy in Chronicles
H3328.short: Izhar was a descendant of Asher mentioned among the genealogies of the twelve tribes of Israel.

H3324.name: Izhar
H3324.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3324.brief: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi; father of Korah.
H3324.short: Izhar (or Amminadab), son of Kohath and father of Korah, was a Levite.

H3300G.name: Jaasiel
H3300G.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3300G.brief: One of David's mighty warriors, the son of Abner.
H3300G.short: Jaasiel, the son of Abner, was one of David's mighty warriors.

H3300H.name: Jaasiel
H3300H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3300H.brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during David's reign.
H3300H.short: Jaasiel, the son of Abner, was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during King David's reign.

H3348.name: Jakeh
H3348.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3348.brief: Father of Agur, the author of Proverbs 30
H3348.short: Jakeh was the father of Agur, the author of Proverbs 30.

H3356H.name: Jakim
H3356H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3356H.short: Jakim was the head of the 12th priestly division during David's reign.

H3356G.name: Jakim
H3356G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3356G.short: Jakim was a Benjamite, the son of Shimei, mentioned in a genealogy.

H3315.name: Japheth
H3315.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3315.brief: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples
H3315.short: Japheth was one of Noah's three sons and the ancestor of the Indo-European peoples.

H3309I.name: Japhia
H3309I.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H3309I.brief: Son of David, born in Jerusalem
H3309I.short: Japhia was one of King David's sons, born to him in Jerusalem.

H3309G.name: Japhia
H3309G.brief: King of Lachish, defeated by Joshua
H3309G.short: Japhia was the king of Lachish, one of the Amorite cities defeated by Joshua.

H3310.name: Japhlet
H3310.brief: Descendant of Asher, son of Heber
H3310.short: Japhlet was a descendant of Asher and the son of Heber.

H3382G.name: Jared
H3382G.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H3382G.brief: Ancestor of Noah; father of Enoch
H3382G.short: Jared was an ancestor of Noah and the father of Enoch, who walked with God.

H3398.name: Jarha
H3398.desc: Egyptian living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3398.brief: Egyptian servant who married Sheshan's daughter
H3398.short: Jarha was an Egyptian servant who married the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah.

H3386.name: Jaroah
H3386.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3386.short: Jaroah was a Gadite, the son of Gilead, mentioned in a genealogy.

H3360.name: Jekameam
H3360.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3360.short: Jekameam was a Levite, the son of Hebron, mentioned in the genealogies of the Levites in 1 Chronicles.

H3359G.name: Jekamiah
H3359G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3359G.brief: Son of Shallum, a descendant of Judah.
H3359G.short: Jekamiah was a descendant of Judah through Shallum, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3359H.name: Jekamiah
H3359H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3359H.brief: Descendant of Jeconiah, a descendant of David.
H3359H.short: Jekamiah was a descendant of Jeconiah and a descendant of David, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3354.name: Jekuthiel
H3354.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3354.brief: Son of Mered, founder of Zanoah.
H3354.short: Jekuthiel was the son of Mered and the  father (ie founder) of Zanoah, as recorded in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

H3316H.name: Jephthah
H3316H.brief: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.
H3316H.short: Jephthah was a judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the Ammonites but made a tragic vow that resulted in the sacrifice of his daughter.

H3312H.name: Jephunneh
H3312H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3312H.short: Jephunneh is mentioned in the genealogy of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

H3312G.name: Jephunneh
H3312G.desc: Caleb's father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3312G.brief: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.
H3312G.short: Jephunneh, a Kenizzite, was the father of Caleb, one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

H3392.name: Jerah
H3392.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3392.brief: A son of Joktan, descendant of Shem.
H3392.short: Jerah was one of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, as recorded in the Table of Nations in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H3396H.name: Jerahmeel
H3396H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3396H.brief: A Levite of the Merari clan.
H3396H.short: Jerahmeel was a Levite of the family of Merari, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3396G.name: Jerahmeel
H3396G.brief: Son of Hezron, a descendant of Judah.
H3396G.short: Jerahmeel was the son of Hezron and a prominent figure in the genealogy of Judah, with his descendants being called the Jerahmeelites.

H3396I.name: Jerahmeel
H3396I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3396I.brief: Son of Hammelech, sent to arrest Jeremiah.
H3396I.short: Jerahmeel, the son of Hammelech, was one of the officers sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest Jeremiah and Baruch.

H3382H.name: Jered
H3382H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3382H.brief: Son of Mered, founder of Gedor.
H3382H.short: Jered was the son of Mered and the  father (ie founder) of Gedor, as recorded in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

H3379G.name: Jeroboam
H3379G.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchyand Divided Monarchy
H3379G.brief: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.
H3379G.short: Jeroboam I was the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel after the split of the united monarchy following Solomon's reign.

H3379H.name: Jeroboam
H3379H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3379H.brief: King of Israel, son of Jehoash.
H3379H.short: Jeroboam II was a king of Israel who reigned for 41 years, restoring some of Israel's former territories.

H3395K.name: Jeroham
H3395K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3395K.brief: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H3395K.short: Jeroham was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H3395L.name: Jeroham
H3395L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3395L.brief: A leader from the tribe of Dan.
H3395L.short: Jeroham was a leader from the tribe of Dan during the reign of King David.

H3395H.name: Jeroham
H3395H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3395H.short: Jeroham was a Benjamite, the son of Jeshaiah, mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

H3395J.name: Jeroham
H3395J.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H3395J.short: Jeroham was a priest, the father of Adaiah, who served in the temple during the time of Nehemiah.

H3395I.name: Jeroham
H3395I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3395I.short: Jeroham was a Benjamite, the father of Ibneiah, mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

H3395G.name: Jeroham
H3395G.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H3395G.brief: An Ephraimite, father of Elkanah and grandfather of Samuel.
H3395G.short: Jeroham was an Ephraimite, the father of Elkanah and grandfather of the prophet Samuel.

H3395M.name: Jeroham
H3395M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3395M.brief: Father of Azariah, who supported Jehoiada's coup.
H3395M.short: Jeroham was the father of Azariah, one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada in overthrowing Athaliah and installing Joash as king.

H3388.name: Jerusha
H3388.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3388.brief: Mother of King Jotham of Judah.
H3388.short: Jerusha was the mother of King Jotham of Judah and the daughter of Zadok.

H3337.name: Jezer
H3337.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3337.brief: Son of Naphtali, founder of the Jezerite clan
H3337.short: Jezer, a son of Naphtali, was the ancestor of the Jezerite clan.

H3370.name: Jokshan
H3370.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3370.brief: A son of Abraham and Keturah
H3370.short: Jokshan was one of the sons born to Abraham and his wife Keturah after the death of Sarah.

H3355.name: Joktan
H3355.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3355.brief: Son of Eber and ancestor of Arabian tribes
H3355.short: Joktan, a descendant of Shem through Eber, was the ancestor of several Arabian tribes.

H3316G.name: Iphtah
H3316G.brief: A town in the Shephelah of Judah
H3316G.short: Iphtah, a town in the Shephelah region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:43">Joshua 15:43</ref>).

H3317.name: Iphtahel Valley
H3317.brief: A valley on the border of Zebulun and Asher
H3317.short: The Iphtahel Valley, on the border between Zebulun and Asher (<ref="Joshua 19:14, 27">Joshua 19:14, 27</ref>).

H3309H.name: Japhia
H3309H.brief: A town on the border of Zebulun
H3309H.short: Japhia, a town on the border of Zebulun's territory (<ref="Joshua 19:12">Joshua 19:12</ref>).

H3343.name: Jekabzeel
H3343.brief: A town in Judah inhabited after the Babylonian exile
H3343.short: Jekabzeel, a town in Judah inhabited by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile (<ref="Nehemiah 11:25">Nehemiah 11:25</ref>).

H3385.name: Jeruel
H3385.brief: A wilderness where Jehoshaphat defeated his enemies
H3385.short: The Wilderness of Jeruel, where Jehoshaphat and Judah defeated their enemies (<ref="2Ch.20.16">2Ch.20.16</ref>).

H3389.name: Jerusalem
H3389.brief: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions
H3389.short: Jerusalem, the capital of Israel and a holy city for Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.

H3347.name: Jokdeam
H3347.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H3347.short: Jokdeam, a town in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:56">Joshua 15:56</ref>).

H3362.name: Jokneam
H3362.brief: A Canaanite city, later a Levitical city in Zebulun
H3362.short: Jokneam (or Jokmeam), a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, later allotted to the Levites within the territory of Zebulun.

H3371G.name: Joktheel
H3371G.brief: A town in the Shephelah region of Judah
H3371G.short: Joktheel, a town in the Shephelah (lowland) region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:38">Joshua 15:38</ref>).

H3305.name: Joppa
H3305.brief: An ancient seaport, the main port for Jerusalem
H3305.short: Joppa, an ancient seaport on the Mediterranean coast, served as the main port for Jerusalem in biblical times.

H3383.name: Jordan
H3383.brief: A river and region, significant in Israel's history
H3383.short: The Jordan River and its surrounding region played a significant role in the history of Israel, from the time of the patriarchs to the New Testament era.

H3375.name: Yiron
H3375.brief: A town allotted to the tribe of Naphtali
H3375.short: Yiron, a town in the territory of Naphtali, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to the tribe during the division of the Promised Land (<ref="Josh. 19:38">Josh. 19:38</ref>).
